name: TC-06-maintenance-request-lifecycle-full
description: TC-06.1-06.4: Maintenance Request — Standard flow, emergency bypass, reopen, and SLA field verification

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — Maintenance Request List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Maintenance Request. MRs progress through: Draft → Pending Approval → Approved → Release → Completed. Emergency MRs can bypass the approval queue.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — MR List Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance request list shows all MRs with their priority, status, requester, and SLA indicator. Filter by status to see pending, approved, or completed requests.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — New MR Form
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a maintenance request. Enter the description, priority (Low/Medium/High/Emergency), site, department, and requested by information.

steps.value: E2E Full Lifecycle — Pump vibration above threshold

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — Fill Description
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Full Lifecycle — Pump vibration abov" into the Description field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — MR Created (Draft)
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance request is created in 'Draft' state with an auto-generated ID (e.g., MR-00001). Submit for approval to advance the workflow.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — MR Detail View
doc_metadata.caption: The MR detail page shows all fields, priority badge, workflow state, and SLA tracking fields. SLA Response Due and SLA Resolution Due are auto-populated based on priority level.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06 — Checklist List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Checklist. Checklists are linked to maintenance requests and work orders to ensure all required inspection points are completed.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06 — Checklist Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The checklist list shows all inspection checklists with their linked entity, completion status, and number of items checked.
